def transform_new(g):
    bg=min(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in g)) if False else None
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    r=0
    while r<len(g):
        if all(v==bg for v in g[r]):
            r+=1; continue
        end=r
        while end<len(g) and any(v!=bg for v in g[end]): end+=1
        rightmost=[max((c for c,v in enumerate(g[i]) if v!=bg),default=-1) for i in range(r,end)]
        mx=max(rightmost)
        if mx < len(g[0])-1:
            for i,last in zip(range(r,end),rightmost):
                if last==mx:
                    for c in range(mx+1,len(g[0])): out[i][c]=1
        r=end
    return out
out=transform_new(grid)
print([(i, max((c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=0),default=-1)) for i,row in enumerate(grid) if any(row)])
print(__import__('json').dumps(out))

from collections import Counter

def transform_v2(g):
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    bands=[]; r=0
    while r<len(g):
        if all(v==bg for v in g[r]):
            r+=1; continue
        s=r
        while r<len(g) and any(v!=bg for v in g[r]): r+=1
        bands.append((s,r))
    if len(bands)>=2:
        (a,b),(c,d)=bands[0],bands[1]
        if b-a==d-c:
            count1=sum(v!=bg for row in g[a:b] for v in row)
            count2=sum(v!=bg for row in g[c:d] for v in row)
            if count1>=count2: src,dst=a,c
            else: src,dst=c,a
            h=b-a
            for k in range(h):
                sr=src+k; dr=dst+k
                occ=[j for j,v in enumerate(g[dr]) if v!=bg]
                if not occ: continue
                last=max(occ)
                for j in range(last+1,len(g[dr])):
                    if g[sr][j]!=bg and g[dr][j]==bg: out[dr][j]=1
    return out
out2=transform_v2(grid)
print(__import__('json').dumps(out2))
